from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError

def reminder_due(renewal_at: datetime, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
    now = now or datetime.now()
    return renewal_at - timedelta(days=REMINDER_DAYS_BEFORE) <= now < renewal_at

    """First renewal strictly after ``after``."""
    after = ensure_utc(after)
    start = ensure_utc(sub.started_at)
    period_days = sub.period_days
    if isinstance(period_days, bool) or not isinstance(period_days, int) or period_days <= 0:
        raise BillingError("invalid_period", repr(period_days))
    length = timedelta(days=period_days)
    if after < start:
        return start + length
    n = (after - start) // length
    renewal = start + (n + 1) * length
    while renewal <= after:
        renewal += length
    return renewal
